The '''Festival of the Eternal Alliance''' was an event celebrating the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s victory [[War against Zakuul|over]] the [[Eternal Empire]] after the [[Battle of Zakuul]]<ref name="KOTET 9" /> in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="KOTET dates" /> The party was organized by [[Magistrate of Revelry|High Imperator of Revelry]] [[Indo Zal]], who spent the cost of a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] on the [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] [[Raz and the Ubo-Kings]]. During the festival, Zal gave a toast congratulating the [[Alliance Commander]] for the victory over the Empire.<ref name="Mail" />

After the party, Indo Zal redacted a letter to the Alliance Commander mentioning that the party had been his finest work, and that [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] would talk about it for generations. He also informed the Commander that he had exceeded the budget for the party, but the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Gault Rennow]] assured him that he could get the rest of the [[Currency/Legends|money]] needed to cover the event.<ref name="Mail" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Festival of the Eternal Alliance was mentioned in an in-game letter in the [[2016]] digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The letter is made available when the player finishes the main storyline of ''Knights of the Eternal Throne''.<ref name="Mail" />
